# Raze config.txt fragment. The OS config.txt includes it at top level. It holds ONLY the product's own
# choices. Everything the board's devices need is generated by Lemnos from the board file (format
# pending Lemnos Q2a), and goes in the placeholder below.

# GPU (V3D) and display (KMS). The product's choice: HeliOS wants it, and dma-buf frame streams
# allocate from it.
dtoverlay=vc4-kms-v3d-pi5

# Crash logs kept in RAM across a reset (pstore, ramoops): 256 KiB at 0x0b000000, 128 KiB of it the
# console log and two 64 KiB panic/oops records. Kept for the support bundle: a crash on a robot
# leaves its last log. The sizes are dev's, measured on a Raze.
dtoverlay=ramoops-pi5,total-size=0x40000,record-size=0x10000,console-size=0x20000

# ---- LEMNOS-OWNED LINES: PLACEHOLDER (Lemnos Q2a) ----
# The boot-time pin states (USB power on, fan duty) are config.txt lines Lemnos writes in its own later
# steps (`tree --boot-dir`, and at L2 the boot-partition step). They are NOT written by the Gaia generate step
# of PR B27: Gaia has no key for config.txt lines by design. Nothing is written yet, so the board does not get
# its pin states from this file until Lemnos's step exists.
# ---- END LEMNOS-OWNED PLACEHOLDER ----
